title: A Causal Explainable Guardrails for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating responses to prompts from the BOLD benchmark and ToxiGen dataset targeting specific racial and ethnic groups (e.g., Black, Native American, Latino), and measuring the VADER sentiment score, refusal rates, and toxicity using a fine-tuned HateBERT classifier.

Evaluating model responses to gender-related prompts from the BOLD benchmark and ToxiGen dataset (e.g., targeting women) by analyzing VADER sentiment scores, refusal percentages, and toxicity classifications.
Measuring VADER sentiment scores, toxicity percentages, and refusal rates on generated text responding to prompts about religious groups (e.g., Muslim, Jewish) using the BOLD and ToxiGen benchmarks.
Evaluating imbalances in generated text sentiment across different political ideologies using prompts from the BOLD benchmark and analyzing the outputs via VADER sentiment scores.
Assessing the sentiment of generated text across various professions using the BOLD benchmark by applying VADER sentiment analysis to the model's responses.
